advancements.adventure.sleep_in_bed.desc: Sleep in a bed to skip the night
block.minecraft.spawn.not_valid: You have no spawn point set or charged respawn anchor, or it was obstructed
block.bonfires_ex.bonfire_place_fail: You can't place a Bonfire here.
emi.info.bonfires_ex.ash_pile: Obtained sometimes from mobs when burnt to death.
emi.info.bonfires_ex.coiled_sword: Place a Coiled Sword on top of a Pile of Bone and Ash to create a new Bonfire.
emi.info.bonfires_ex.coiled_sword_fragme: Hold the item and [Use] to return to the last Bonfire you rested in. Up to 6 times.
emi.info.bonfires_ex.titanite_any: Place it in the inventory to Reinforce weapons in a Bonfire.
emi.info.bonfires_ex.undead_bone_shard: The Undead Bone Shard is obtained when a bonfire is destroyed by an explosion. Use it to Reinforce an Estus Flask in a Bonfire.
emi.info.bonfires_ex.homeward_bone: Hold the item and [Use] to return to the last Bonfire you rested in.
emi.info.bonfires_ex.estus_shard: Hold a Estus Shard and [Use] to increase the number of uses of an Estus Flask placed in the inventory.
emi.info.bonfires_ex.estus_flask: Consume it to instantly regain health. Rest in a Bonfire to replenish its uses.
text.config.bonfires_ex_config.option.di: Experimental! Drastically reduce TPS usage in the Travel Menu.
